caller_chain_review_summary.name_collision_check: Candidate chains use duplicate symbols `run` (74 definitions) and `hardline` (3 definitions). Each used source reference was checked: run→handle_console is app.rs:136; run→prewarm_sidecar_container_status cli/prewarm.rs:145; run→run_accounts cli/usage.rs:567; hardline→hardline_docker_agent_with_focus backend.rs:105. Backend::hardline is resolved by backend_for_state match at attach/hardline.rs:35-45. Other candidate function symbols are unique in non-test Rust files, except run_inner, which is not a chain edge.
caller_chain_review_summary.scope_limit: Static call expressions and their enclosing function declarations verified; source-only, not execution. Outer binary bootstrap not included.
